name: animated-modal

frames.best_why: Fully open panel with the photo fan, heading and detail list all sharp.

tagline: Travel booking dialog springs up over a blurred page with a fan of photos.
summary: A dark rounded dialog with a bold trip heading, a stack of tilted travel photos and a short details list. It opens from a tilted, shrunken pose over a dimmed blurred page.
appearance: A dark rounded dialog over a blurred black backdrop, with a small close X in its top corner. A bold white heading sits above four overlapping tilted photos, with a two-column list of short trip details beneath.
behaviour: Clicking the white trigger button dims and blurs the page, then the panel springs in from a tilted, smaller pose. The close X or a click outside dismisses it, and the page unblurs.
demo_content: Heading 'Your summer escape, booked ✈️', four tilted travel photos, and trip details like flights from 6 cities.
search_phrases: modal that springs up from the page
popup with a stack of photos
center screen card over blurred background
modal with close x in the corner
use_when: A short focused flow, like confirming a booking, needs to interrupt the page without leaving it.
avoid_when: The footer is clipped in the recorded demo, and nothing handles Escape, which keyboard users expect.
customise: Compose Modal, ModalTrigger, ModalBody, ModalContent and ModalFooter with your own content and classes. The spring, 3D tilt, blur and overlay are fixed.
weight_why: A single spring-animated panel and blur overlay; no canvas or loops.

a11y.note: No Escape handling, no focus trap, and the close button is an unlabelled X; the entry spring ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The Cancel and Book now footer is clipped out of the open panel in frames 3 and 4.
No Escape-key close, and the X button has no accessible label.
polish_why: Strong spring entrance and a tidy photo fan; the footer is clipped and the panel is very dark.
title: Animated Modal
